== Description ==

Four players at a side table in a meeting room at the [[2022 World Championship]] in Atlanta. Third from the left, in a grey shirt, is [[Hayes Hunter]], gesturing as he talks. The other three are not yet identified. The poster's caption called the player at the left "the Stinkbug King".

== Source and credit ==

* '''Source:''' Star Wars CCG Slack, #worlds-2022, CRG, 22 October 2022 (11:04 Eastern): "The Stinkbug King, Stinkbugging, while Hayes complains about the game's rules." Original file name: IMG_4358.jpg (4032×3024); Slack file id F047LBPA9FX.
* '''Shared by:''' CRG (Slack)
* '''Date:''' not recorded (posted 22 October 2022; taken in the event room during the weekend).
* '''Identification:''' [[Hayes Hunter]] (third from left, grey shirt, gesturing) is named as Hayes in the post and is the same person as in [[:File:2022 World Championship Hayes Hunter with a player.jpg]] and #6 in [[:File:2022 World Championship Top 8.jpg]]. The other three are not yet identified. The poster's caption calls the player at the left "the Stinkbug King".

Unknown faces are listed on [[Unidentified event photographs]]; if you recognise someone, please say so on the [https://swccg.com/forum/viewforum.php?f=4 SWCCG Forum] or this File's Talk page.
